intro_uz: Yaqindagi bog'da dam olib o'tirasiz. Yoningizdagi Sam — qiziquvchan qo'shni — itini sayrga olib chiqqan va siz bilan gaplashmoqchi. O'zingizni tanishtiring, qiziqishlaringiz haqida gapiring va yana uchrashishni taklif qiling.
setting: A bench in a small London park at the weekend. Sam is nearby with a dog, kids playing football in the background.

objectives.title_uz: Sam haqida ham biror narsa so'rang

fallback_lines: Nice one! So what do you do for fun around here?
Oh really? Tell me a bit more about that.
Sorry, the dog was barking — what did you say?
opening_line: Hey! Sorry, is this bench free? Lovely day, isn't it?
level5_complication: Sam invites the player to a party on a day they said they were busy, so the player must politely decline and suggest another time.
